description:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon. 

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, 
twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the 
moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or 
services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and 
connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. 
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to 
operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and 
launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore 
across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and 
discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment 
designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the 
world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
With teams across the Amazon universe, you don’t have to choose one 
path too early. You’ll take ownership, build new skills, and shape a 
career that evolves as you do.

Key job responsibilities
- Completing project tasks with a team of other Amazon engineers 
- Utilizing Amazon engineering tools and processes 
- Prototyping and testing concepts or features 
- Tracking progress of task deliverables 
- Developing and maintaining design documentation 
- Presenting information to managers and engineers

A day in the life
As an Amazonian, you will be matched to a manager and a team, and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and work on critical projects early in your career. 

In addition to working on impactful projects, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in various activities. We give you the tools to own your projects and learn in a real-world settings.

About the team
Explore Robotics Teams at Amazon

At Amazon, robotics is where innovative research meets real-world deployment. There are many different specialized robotics teams, including the few highlighted below. Learn more about Robotics at Amazon here: https://www.amazon.science/research-areas/robotics

Fulfillment Technologies and Robotics
We build dynamic partnerships between people and intelligent machines. This intricate collaboration helps Amazon fulfill orders with unmatched accuracy. Working in symphony with our robotic technology, you’ll have the opportunity to extend your technical capabilities by working alongside some of the industry’s most advanced technologies. This includes our fleet of autonomous mobile robots, sophisticated control software, and technologies like language perception, machine learning, object recognition, and semantic understanding of commands. These technologies help us deliver an ever-improving customer and employee experience, as well as improve the safety of our facilities.

Amazon Robotics
Amazon Robotics is at the epicenter of robotics innovation. We design, test, and build mobile robots and mechatronic systems. Our offices, labs, test floors, and factories are close together, which means we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build, and watch it all come to life. Our areas of focus include advancements in autonomous mobility, AI, robotic management software, and much more.

Fauna
Fauna is focused on building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Fauna’s goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with everyday. Fauna develops tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Fauna’s work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but overall experience.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies develops tech solutions that create network optimizations for all Amazon sites worldwide. We own network infrastructure and devices in all buildings and labor planning and scheduling technology for fulfillment centers in North America and Europe.
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- Knowledge of material and manufacturing methods
- Knowledge of schematic design and debug skills
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience in 3D CAD
- Experience in analog and digital skills with embedded systems
- Experience in embedded systems projects
- Knowledge of SolidWorks or similar CAD experience and understanding of best practices for part design, and advanced assemblies
- Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems
- Experience integrating component modules (I/O, Displays, Batteries, etc.)
- Experience with hardware/software integration and real-time systems
- Experience with high volume/high finish CE Enclosure materials
- Experience with product level validation testing (Thermal, EMC/EMI, Shock, Cycle Testing, etc.)
- Experience with FMEA, FMEDA, or fault tree analysis
- Experience with PDM/PLM systems (SolidWorks PDM, Agile, or similar)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The starting pay for this position is listed below. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits .
